jobs.label: Mathematics
jobs.subject: A carved folded mathematical surface: one continuous ivory sheet bends into an elegant compact saddle with two rising folded lobes and a deep central valley, its near edge displaying subtle thickness. Visually coherent sculptural geometry; no symbols, equation or implied measured surface.
